'''Be'Seario''' was a [[Holorecorder/Legends|holorecorder]] operator working with [[Eye on Cularin]] reporter [[Yara Grugara]]. Be'Seario traveled with her to [[Genarius]] when she interviewed [[Broof Yurdel]] of the [[Cularin Militia]].
